sn56.5:1.1: Ye hi keci bhikkhave atītam addhānam samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yathābhūtam abhisambujjhiṃsu || sabbe te cattāri ariyasaccāni yathābhūtam abhisambujjhissanti || || 3.
sn56.5:1.3: Ye pi hi keci bhikkhave etarahi samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yathābhūtam abhisambujjhanti sabbe te cattāri ariyasaccāni yathābhūtam abhisambujjhanti || ||
sn56.5:2.2: Dukkham ariyasaccam || la || dukkhanirodhagāminī patipadā ariyasaccaṃ || || 5.
sn56.5:2.3: Ye pi hi keci bhikkhave atītam addhānam samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā va yathābhūtam abhisambujjhiṃsu || abhisambujjhissanti
sn56.5:2.5: sabbe te imāni cattāri ariyasaccāni yathābhūtam abhisambujjhanti || ||
